title: Is playing two balls allowed in match play?
question: If you’re playing match play and are not sure what the correct rule is for your situation, are you allowed to play two balls and count both scores?

choices.text: Yes, you can always play two balls in match play
No, you must work out the situation with your opponent or ask for a ruling
Only if your marker gives permission
Only if you are playing alone

explanation: In match play, you are not allowed to play two balls. You and your opponent must agree what to do, or ask for a ruling from a referee if you can’t agree.
